fact: From 4 to 8 November 2024 ISTAG-Mali held a digital archiving training seminar for about twenty cadres of the Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries in Bamako, with staff of the Ministry of Agriculture also attending.
title: Mali: l'ISTAG outille une vingtaine de cadres du ministère de l'élevage et de la peche en l'Archivage Numérique
